queries.text: Series title follows the glossary proposal "Man’s Suffering in Love" (O Sofrimento Amoroso do Homem), as in the other volumes.
The citation gives the English titles; the Portuguese originals are "O Sofrimento Amoroso do Homem: O Profano Feminino (Considerações sobre a Face da Mulher que Ninguém Quer Encarar)".

The author’s notice forbids any alteration of the book’s "language or title" (this 2005 edition does not list "translate" explicitly, unlike the 2008 edition). Translated faithfully; a human must confirm that this English edition is authorized before publication (as for the other volumes).

The table of contents reads "Como elas minam a desconfiança" (How they undermine distrust), but the chapter heading itself is "O enfraquecimento das desconfianças" (The weakening of suspicions). Both kept as in the original, as in the 2008 edition.
